title: DataTradeOffers
description: Allows trades to be made using json in data packs!
body:
## Data Trade Offers
This mod works by introducing two new resource types in data packs. First is the trade offers, which are the actual trades themselves. The second is professions, which tells the game what trades can be in the profession's pool and what cannot be in the profession's pool. The second part is useful for modpacks to remove trades from a pool.

The trade offers work similar to the vanilla TradeOffers.Factory, meaning you can add explorer maps, dyed gear, enchanted items, and anything else that is supported by the factories!
